$comment: Channel Routing and the Spire twist (P2.2) at Thousand-Bough's Flume Gallery (Q2.5, Fen): three crews' water from their gates to their own wheels on the Gate Board (the board, its tiles and the crews' colours are the game's). Rounds 1-2 turn tiles so no water mixes; round 3 picks where each crew works (puzzles/workspaces.json); the twist asks why two crews' previews jam at one Lookout. `crews` names each crew and what its water carries (on the gates' boards, the overlay and in words, never colour alone); `demo` is the cold open's two title cards; `twist` is the Spire's question and its four answers (`line`: Fen's voiced reply). For the Copilot app course: 02 §Worktrees (one branch, one folder each), §Previews (one port each).

old.title: One shared trough
old.text: Every crew’s water runs down the same trough, so it all mixes into mud.

new.title: One channel per crew
new.text: Each crew’s water stays in its own channel, all the way to its own wheel.

twist.question: Feature and Docs both want to show their work at Lookout 5173. Their channels are separate. So why are they stuck?

text.solved1: Feature’s water turns Feature’s wheel. One crew, one channel.
text.solved: Every crew’s water turns its own wheel, and nothing mixed.
